name: Mornington Peninsula

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Its Chardonnay typically shows melon, citrus and fig.

blurb.text: A cool-climate region south of Melbourne in Victoria's Port Phillip area, focused on Pinot Noir, with Chardonnay and Pinot Gris too. Pinot Noir is 55 percent of plantings.
